text:
lee: quick Q  need to run a short weekend load test for a latency regression. Prefer A100 x4 in us-west2 for ~4h on Sunday. Any chance of a temporary borrow?

hana: what's the workload shape and when exactly? we might be able to do a partial if full 4 GPUs aren't free.

lee: starting 06:00 PT Sun, target 90min steady-state, spike to 3k RPS. mostly chat inference, seq len 256. want stable low tail-latency.

devon: I'll check vendor availability. FYI finance prefers temporary borrow requests under 48h.

procurement-bot: vendor inventory query returned: compact racks with A100 available in us-west2 (2 racks) but require manual approval. portal: https://vendor.example.com/allocs/78901

hana: can you submit the portal request and add the terraform tag? use :team:inference and :run:weekend

devon: opening request now. terraform label to include: ```hcl
resource "vendor_alloc" "wkend_borrow" {
  region = "us-west2"
  sku = "A100-40GB"
  count = 4
  window_start = "2024-07-07T06:00:00Z"
  window_end = "2024-07-07T10:00:00Z"
  notes = "latency-regression-smoke"
  tags = ["team-inference","weekend-borrow"]
}
```

procurement-bot: allocation request submitted (#RB-9901). Pending approval from procurement + ops-oncall. Link: https://vendor.example.com/requests/9901

ops-oncall: quick note  check cloud GPU quotas before vendor provision. last audit showed soft-limit at project level for A100 in us-west2.

devon: opened cloud quota ticket CQ-3399 for +4 A100. Also pinged security for isolated VPC check.

hana: if quota clearance is slow, can we run a 2x A100 partial baseline? we can validate tail latency then iterate.

lee: partial is acceptable if needed. priority is verifying the regression fix.

procurement-bot: procurement approved RB-9901 (temporary). Vendor ETA: 2 hours to provision once cloud quota is confirmed.

devon: cloud quota approved CQ-3399. Security ACKed isolated VPC for the test. ops-oncall, please confirm there's no maintenance window Sunday morning.

ops-oncall: no maintenance scheduled. you have green light from infra.

hana: awesome. i'll standby to run the harness. lee, please drop the exact git PR that wires up the test runner.

lee: PR is https://github.com/redwood-inference/tests/pull/202 - contains job config and warmup sequence. kicking at 06:05 PT Sun.

procurement-bot: vendor has provisioned partial rack (2x A100) under temp request RB-9901-P1. Notify when you want to scale to full 4.

lee: starting with 2 GPUs to capture latency baseline, then request full scale after 30m if all good.

devon: noted. i'll request vendor scale when you give go. keep this thread updated so we can close the request cleanly.

lee: run complete, 2x A100 baseline looks good. tail p95 improved vs last run. asking to scale to 4 now.

procurement-bot: vendor scaled RB-9901 to full (4x A100).

lee: full run complete, teardown scheduled 10:30 PT. uploading perf CSV to shared drive: https://drive.redwood.ai/inference/perf/2024-07-07-wkend-run.csv

hana: thanks. vendor release?

procurement-bot: RB-9901 closed, racks released.

devon: confirmed teardown and closing CQ-3399. I'll capture a short postmortem and add the terraform snippet + checklist to infra-runbooks.

lee: thanks everyone  will add a one-pager with timings so approvals are faster next time. :raised_hands:
